blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No ticket won the jackpots in the Ultra Lotto 6/58 and Super Lotto 6/49 draws on Sunday, Sept. 20, according to the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office. The Ultra Lotto 6/58 winning combination was 28-33-20-02-16-23 for a jackpot of ₱315.34 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. The Super Lotto 6/49 winning combination was 05-33-29-22-12-44 for a jackpot of ₱25.29 million. The jackpot also had no winner.
